title: Sort Array By Parity II
goal: Place even values at even indices and odd values at odd indices.
strategy: Use independent write pointers for even and odd output indices. Each pointer advances by two.

phasePurposes.inspect: Use independent write pointers for even and odd output indices. Each pointer advances by two.
phasePurposes.update: Every output index has the same parity as its value.
phasePurposes.done: Every output index has the same parity as its value.

inputRules: Inputs are validated against this algorithm’s domain and the documented visualization size limits.
